# KABS AI LABS

> KABS AI LABS builds AI agents, workflow automation, and analytics dashboards end-to-end for agencies, SaaS, eCommerce, and service businesses — automating operations so teams can scale without hiring. Systems run 24/7 and plug into the tools clients already use.

## Key facts

- **Name:** KABS AI LABS
- **Website:** https://www.kabsailabs.com
- **What we do:** Custom AI agents (chat & voice), workflow automation, and analytics dashboards, built and integrated end-to-end.
- **Who we serve:** Marketing agencies, real estate, eCommerce, SaaS, and healthcare/service businesses.
- **Contact:** hello@kabsailabs.com · WhatsApp +1 406 867 7425
- **Typical results:** 40+ hours/week saved, 24/7 operation, scaling without added headcount.
- **Track record:** 500+ workflows built, 30k+ hours saved, 120+ projects delivered, 98% client satisfaction.
- **Delivery time:** Focused builds ship in 4–6 weeks; larger multi-system builds run 2–4 months in 1–2 week increments.
- **Getting started:** Book a free 30-minute automation audit — no commitment until a fixed-price quote is approved.

## Services

- [AI agents](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/ai-automation): Chat and voice agents that answer, qualify, and act on your behalf.
- [Workflow automation](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/workflow-automation): Connect every tool so data flows and tasks run without a human.
- [Analytics & dashboards](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/analytics): One trustworthy view of the numbers that drive decisions.
- [RAG / knowledge base](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/rag-knowledge-base): Agents that answer from your own documents and data.
- [Voice AI](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/voice-ai): Voice agents that book appointments and handle inbound calls.
- [AI for trades](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/ai-for-trades): Automation for plumbing, HVAC, and field-service businesses.
- [AI for legal & medical docs](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/ai-legal-medical-docs): Summarize and process complex documents.
- [GoHighLevel automation](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/gohighlevel-automation): Done-for-you automation inside GoHighLevel.
- [White-label / agency partners](https://www.kabsailabs.com/services/white-label): Resell automation under your own brand.
